```renyi
module library.grades
  purpose: Convert numeric scores to letter grades and summarize grade counts.

public type Score is Integer where value is at least 0 and value is at most 100
  purpose: A numeric student score from zero to one hundred.

public type LetterGrade is one of
  purpose: A standard letter grade.
  GradeA
  GradeB
  GradeC
  GradeD
  GradeF
end

public type GradeCounts
  purpose: The number of students who received each letter grade.
  has grade_a: Integer
  has grade_b: Integer
  has grade_c: Integer
  has grade_d: Integer
  has grade_f: Integer
end

public function grade_for_score(score: Score) returns LetterGrade
  purpose: Convert one numeric score to its letter grade.
  example: grade_for_score(Score(95)) is GradeA

  if score is at least 90 then
    return GradeA
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return GradeB
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return GradeC
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return GradeD
  otherwise
    return GradeF
  end
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Score) returns GradeCounts
  purpose: Count how many scores fall into each letter grade.
  example: count_grades([Score(95), Score(82), Score(72), Score(63), Score(40)]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 1, grade_b: 1, grade_c: 1, grade_d: 1, grade_f: 1)

  let mutable grade_a_count be 0
  let mutable grade_b_count be 0
  let mutable grade_c_count be 0
  let mutable grade_d_count be 0
  let mutable grade_f_count be 0

  for each score in scores
    match grade_for_score(score)
      when GradeA then set grade_a_count to grade_a_count + 1
      when GradeB then set grade_b_count to grade_b_count + 1
      when GradeC then set grade_c_count to grade_c_count + 1
      when GradeD then set grade_d_count to grade_d_count + 1
      when GradeF then set grade_f_count to grade_f_count + 1
    end
  end

  return GradeCounts(
    grade_a: grade_a_count,
    grade_b: grade_b_count,
    grade_c: grade_c_count,
    grade_d: grade_d_count,
    grade_f: grade_f_count
  )
end
```

```renyi
module school.grades
  purpose: Convert numeric student scores into letter grades and count grade totals.

public type Score is Integer where value is at least 0 and value is at most 100
  purpose: A numeric score from 0 to 100.

public type LetterGrade is one of
  purpose: A usual school letter grade.
  GradeA
  GradeB
  GradeC
  GradeD
  GradeF
end

public type GradeCounts
  purpose: Counts of students receiving each letter grade.
  has grade_a: Integer
  has grade_b: Integer
  has grade_c: Integer
  has grade_d: Integer
  has grade_f: Integer
end

public function grade_for_score(score: Score) returns LetterGrade
  purpose: Convert one numeric score to its letter grade.
  example: grade_for_score(score: Score(95)) is GradeA

  if score is at least 90 then
    return GradeA
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return GradeB
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return GradeC
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return GradeD
  otherwise
    return GradeF
  end
end

public function grades_for_scores(scores: List of Score) returns List of LetterGrade
  purpose: Convert numeric scores to letter grades.
  example: grades_for_scores(scores: [Score(95), Score(82), Score(58)]) is [GradeA, GradeB, GradeF]

  return for each score in scores collect grade_for_score(score: score)
end

public function count_grades(grades: List of LetterGrade) returns GradeCounts
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade.
  example: count_grades(grades: [GradeA, GradeB, GradeA, GradeF]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 2, grade_b: 1, grade_c: 0, grade_d: 0, grade_f: 1)

  let mutable counts be GradeCounts(grade_a: 0, grade_b: 0, grade_c: 0, grade_d: 0, grade_f: 0)

  for each grade in grades
    match grade
      when GradeA then set counts to counts with grade_a: counts.grade_a + 1
      when GradeB then set counts to counts with grade_b: counts.grade_b + 1
      when GradeC then set counts to counts with grade_c: counts.grade_c + 1
      when GradeD then set counts to counts with grade_d: counts.grade_d + 1
      when GradeF then set counts to counts with grade_f: counts.grade_f + 1
    end
  end

  return counts
end

public function count_scores(scores: List of Score) returns GradeCounts
  purpose: Count letter grades directly from numeric scores.
  example: count_scores(scores: [Score(100), Score(91), Score(73), Score(61)]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 2, grade_b: 0, grade_c: 1, grade_d: 1, grade_f: 0)

  let grades be grades_for_scores(scores: scores)
  return count_grades(grades: grades)
end
```

```renyi
module grades.library
  purpose: Turn numeric scores into letter grades and count grade totals.

public type Score is Integer where value is at least 0 and value is at most 100
  purpose: A score from zero to one hundred.

public type LetterGrade is one of
  purpose: A standard school letter grade.
  GradeA
  GradeB
  GradeC
  GradeD
  GradeF
  can Equal
  can Hash
  can ToText
end

public function grade_for_score(score: Score) returns LetterGrade
  purpose: Convert a score into a letter grade.
  example: grade_for_score(score: Score(95) otherwise fail) is GradeA

  if score is at least 90 then
    return GradeA
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return GradeB
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return GradeC
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return GradeD
  otherwise
    return GradeF
  end
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Score) returns Map of LetterGrade to Integer
  purpose: Count how many scores earned each letter grade.
  example: count_grades(scores: [Score(95) otherwise fail, Score(82) otherwise fail, Score(58) otherwise fail]).get(GradeA) otherwise 0 is 1

  let mutable counts be {
    GradeA: 0,
    GradeB: 0,
    GradeC: 0,
    GradeD: 0,
    GradeF: 0
  }

  for each score in scores
    let grade be grade_for_score(score: score)
    let current be counts.get(grade) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: grade, value: current + 1)
  end

  return counts
end
```
